stages.title: The Foundling Wheel

stages.title: After the gala

stages.title: The search
stages.journal: $toc_starsector_firstName got away. The Hegemony is looking; so are you.

stages.title: The reckoning
stages.journal: $toc_starsector_name is hiding at Agreus, in Arcadia.

cases.text: Ten thousand credits lighter, you watch the Hegemony fleet form up and leave. Varro waves. You don't.
Varro's fleet leaves with a polite apology and an even more polite reminder that the debt is still on file.
The Hegemony fleet limps away, and somewhere a revenue officer is filing a report with the word "assault" in it, several times.

phrases.otherwise: You never let the tax collector catch you. By now, a report with your name on it is on its way to every Hegemony office in the sector.
